tool_schemas.name: search_pubmed
tool_schemas.description: Searches PubMed using the provided title/abstract keywords and/or author names and returns up to num_results matching PubMed IDs along with a formatted result payload; results are returned as a single page limited by num_results (no cursor/offset pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if num_results is not a positive integer or if keywords/authors are not arrays of strings, and NOT_FOUND if the query yields zero PubMed matches. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to run searches or access cached search history.

tool_schemas.name: format_paper_details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches normalized metadata for the provided list of PubMed IDs and returns a list of formatted article-detail objects in the same order as requested (this endpoint is not paginated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pubmed_ids is missing, empty, or contains non-string/duplicate IDs. Raises NOT_FOUND when one or more PubMed IDs cannot be resolved to stored/available article metadata, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller lacks access or exceeds allowed detail-lookups.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_client
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client identity for the presented credential, including its effective scopes/entitlements and current rolling-24h quota usage. Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials (UNAUTHORIZED) or when the client is deleted (FORBIDDEN).

api_key.description: Client API key credential used to authenticate the request (sent as a parameter in this API surface).

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists search request audit rows for the authenticated client with optional filtering by status and time range. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses requests when the client is not active or quota is exceeded (FORBIDDEN/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS).

api_key.description: Client API key credential used to authenticate the request.

status.description: Filter results by search request lifecycle status.

query_hash.description: Filter results to a specific normalized query hash.

created_after.description: Only include rows created at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Only include rows created before this RFC3339 timestamp.

page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return in one page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search request audit row by id for the authenticated client. Returns the request object including persisted arrays, num_results, status, and any error_message. Refuses access if the row does not belong to the caller (NOT_FOUND) or credentials are invalid (UNAUTHORIZED).

api_key.description: Client API key credential used to authenticate the request.

id.description: Primary key of the search_requests row.

tool_schemas.name: list_article_fetches
tool_schemas.description: Lists article-fetch audit rows for the authenticated client with optional filtering by status, cache_hit, and pubmed_id. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses requests when the client is not active or quota is exceeded (FORBIDDEN/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS).

api_key.description: Client API key credential used to authenticate the request.

status.description: Filter results by article_fetches lifecycle status.

pubmed_id.description: Filter results to a specific PubMed ID.

cache_hit.description: Filter by whether the fetch was served from cache.

created_after.description: Only include rows created at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Only include rows created before this RFC3339 timestamp.

page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return in one page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: list_articles
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized article metadata stored by the service with optional filtering by pubmed_id(s) and status. Returns a paginated list ordered by updated_at descending. Refuses requests with invalid credentials (UNAUTHORIZED) or when the client is not active (FORBIDDEN).

api_key.description: Client API key credential used to authenticate the request.

pubmed_ids.description: Optional list of PubMed IDs to restrict results to (exact match).

status.description: Filter results by article lifecycle status.

updated_after.description: Only include rows updated at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return in one page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_client_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the authenticated API client's lifecycle status between active and suspended (and to deleted when supported). Returns the updated client record. Refuses invalid transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR), attempts to change another client (FORBIDDEN), or changes when already deleted (CONFLICT).

api_key.description: Client API key credential used to authenticate the request; the client referenced is always the caller.

status.description: New status for the calling api_clients row. Only lifecycle-valid transitions are allowed.

metadata.name: PubMedSearch
metadata.description: This backend powers a PubMed search and article-detail formatting API. It stores normalized PubMed article metadata (key fields needed for display), plus an audit trail of search requests and the returned PubMed IDs to support caching, repeatability, and usage controls. Repository: https://github.co
